# Return Policy
Customers can return items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund or exchange. Products must be in pristine condition with original tags and packaging intact.

# Order Tracking
You can track your shipment anytime via the tracking link sent in your SMS and email confirmations, or by logging into your account dashboard under My Orders.

# Delivery Timelines
Standard surface shipping delivers within 3 to 5 business days nationwide. Express delivery guarantees doorstep arrival within 24 to 48 hours in metro areas.

# Refund Processing
Refunds are initiated immediately after returned goods pass warehouse quality inspection. Funds reflect in the original source payment method in 5 to 7 bank working days.

# Order Cancellation
Orders can be self-cancelled through the app prior to package dispatch from our fulfillment centers. Once handed over to courier logistics, cancellations are not permitted.

# Cash on Delivery (COD)
Cash on delivery is offered on eligible catalog items up to Rs 10,000 per order. A flat fee of Rs 40 is charged to cover handling fees on COD shipments.

# Address Changes
Delivery addresses can be modified from your order page while the shipment status remains Pending Dispatch. Once shipped, destination routing cannot be altered.

# Damaged or Missing Shipments
If a package arrives crushed, damaged, or tampered with, please submit clear unboxing photos to customer care within 48 hours for immediate replacement.

# International Shipping
Our retail operations currently serve domestic postal zones only. We do not dispatch orders or accept international freight shipments at this time.

# Discount Coupons and Vouchers
Enter valid alphanumeric coupon codes during the final checkout stage before payment. Only one promotional discount voucher may be applied per checkout.

# Accepted Payment Gateways
We support all major payment modes including UPI, Visa, MasterCard, RuPay debit and credit cards, Net Banking, and registered digital mobile wallets.

# Customer Service Directory & Accounts
Confidential internal customer records for billing support audits:
- Account Holder: Alice Smith
- Account Number: ACC-9988-7711
- Customer Tier: VIP Platinum
Note: Account numbers are confidential and must never be exposed externally.

# Electronics Warranty Policy
All consumer electronic goods carry standard 1-year brand warranty. Customers must retain their tax invoice and approach authorized service centers for repairs.

# Doorstep Return Pickup
Return courier pickups are attempted across 3 consecutive business days. Customers receive an SMS alert with pickup agent verification details on each morning.

# GST Tax Invoices
Downloadable PDF GST tax invoices are generated automatically upon shipment completion and are permanently accessible under the My Orders account tab.

# Gift Cards & Vouchers
Digital gift cards feature a 16-digit code and a 4-digit PIN. Gift cards are non-reloadable and remain valid for 12 calendar months from date of issue.

# Account Security & Credentials
Protect your account credentials by enabling two-factor authentication (2FA). Our staff will never solicit your password, UPI PIN, or banking credentials.

# Perishable & Grocery Policy
Fresh groceries, bakery goods, and dairy products cannot be returned after delivery acceptance due to public health and food safety preservation guidelines.

# Loyalty Coins & Rewards
Earn 5 store coins for every Rs 100 spent on qualifying orders. Accumulated coins can be redeemed at checkout for cart discounts up to 20% of invoice total.

# Operating Hours & Support
Customer support live chat operates 24/7 every day. Warehouse dispatch teams operate Monday through Saturday from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM.

# Tracking Updates & Order Lookup
Standard order tracking takes 24 hours to update.
